Marriage is a union between two individuals, and both partners should be treated with respect and dignity. The Constitution guarantees the right of every individual, including women, to be treated with fairness and respect. Any ideology that suggests otherwise is discriminatory and goes against the principles of justice and equality. No one has the right to dictate a woman's life choices.
HateSpeech: Il posto di una donna è con il marito che la sua famiglia ha trovato per lei.
